name: Abandonment Driven
description: Clings because letting go means being alone forever
behavioral_signature: Over-attaches to people and panics at any sign of distance
under_stress: Becomes suffocating, driving away the very people they need
at_rest: Warm, attentive, slightly too eager to please
will_never: be the one to leave first
unless: leaving first is the only way to avoid being left
